CustomField.description: The date work is due - Jira duedate, Asana due_on. A Date, not a DateTime, for the same reason as Start_Date__c. Asana's due_at (a due time) is not read, and writing due_on clears any due time in Asana. Inbound sync writes it whenever a delivery carries the field, including clearing it.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: When this is due, as a calendar date.
CustomField.label: Due Date
